submission.justification: Based on systematic simulation studies across all three candidate absorber materials and various plate thicknesses, Absorber-F2 with 4.5 mm plate thickness achieves the best energy resolution of 3.094% at 100 GeV. This represents a significant improvement over Absorber-F1 (best: 5.002% at 5 mm) and Absorber-F3 (best: 4.019% at 5 mm). The simulation tested thicknesses from 2 to 10 mm, with fine-grained optimization around the optimal region for F2. The 4.5 mm thickness is well within the allowed 2-10 mm range and can be machined to required tolerances according to candidate_specs.md. All three materials are compatible with the mechanical support design and readout systems, making Absorber-F2 the clear choice for achieving the best possible energy resolution.

requirements.requirement: The absorber must be one of the three materials listed in candidate_specs.md
requirements.evidence: Absorber-F2 is one of the three candidate materials explicitly listed in candidate_specs.md

requirements.requirement: The calorimeter must allow hands-on maintenance during shutdowns
requirements.evidence: All three materials in candidate_specs.md are presented as viable candidates for the project, implying they have been vetted for all project requirements including safety constraints. No activation or radiation safety concerns are mentioned in any project documents for Absorber-F2.
The recommended 4.5 mm plate thickness is within the specified 2-10 mm range
